did: When GitHub refuses a re-run after approval, the pull request turns back into a draft.
The merge gate then readies it, so every check starts again on the approved plan.
The refusal comment now says it is a draft again, or why not.
decided: Any refusal, not only a missing permission, turns the pull request back into a draft.

handback.summary: Approve: a check that failed before approval now starts again at the merge gate, and the test proves it.

behaviors.why: One case: an old failed check no longer fails the merge gate.

tests.why: Fails on main with no fresh start; passes on the branch only because checks restart.
